<translated_code>
import sys
import math

maxn = 8
SZ = 1048576 + 5
MOD = 1000000007

def inc(a, b):
    return a + b - MOD if a + b >= MOD else a + b

def dec(a, b):
    return a - b if a >= b else a + MOD - b

def mul(a, b):
    return (a * b) % MOD

def power(x, k):
    tmp = 1
    while k:
        if k & 1:
            tmp = mul(tmp, x)
        x = mul(x, x)
        k >>= 1
    return tmp

def check(x, y, z, g):
    from itertools import permutations
    lis = [x, y, z]
    for pos in permutations([1, 2, 3], 3):
        flag = True
        for i in range(3):
            if not g[pos[i]][lis[i]]:
                flag = False
                break
        if flag:
            return True
    return False

def dfs1(now, x, y, a, g, p, num):
    used = [True] * 7
    if now == 0 and x == 4 and y == 1:
        pass
    if x == 4:
        sta = 0
        for i in range(1, 7):
            for j in range(i + 1, 7):
                for k in range(j + 1, 7):
                    if check(i, j, k, g):
                        X = Y = Z = -1
                        used[i] = used[j] = used[k] = False
                        for l in range(1, 7):
                            if not used[l]:
                                continue
                            if X == -1:
                                X = l
                            elif Y == -1:
                                Y = l
                            else:
                                Z = l
                        used[i] = used[j] = used[k] = True
                        if Z == -1:
                            continue
                        sta |= num[X][Y][Z]
        p[sta] = inc(p[sta], now)
        return
    g[x][y] = 1
    nxt = mul(now, a[x][y])
    if y == 6:
        dfs1(nxt, x + 1, 1, a, g, p, num)
    else:
        dfs1(nxt, x, y + 1, a, g, p, num)
    g[x][y] = 0
    nxt = mul(now, dec(1, a[x][y]))
    if y == 6:
        dfs1(nxt, x + 1, 1, a, g, p, num)
    else:
        dfs1(nxt, x, y + 1, a, g, p, num)

def dfs2(now, x, y, a, g, p, num, all, Ans):
    if now == 0:
        return
    if x == 7:
        sta = 0
        for i in range(1, 7):
            for j in range(i + 1, 7):
                for k in range(j + 1, 7):
                    if check(i, j, k, g):
                        sta |= num[i][j][k]
        Ans[0] = inc(Ans[0], mul(now, p[all ^ sta]))
        return
    g[x - 3][y] = 1
    nxt = mul(now, a[x][y])
    if y == 6:
        dfs2(nxt, x + 1, 1, a, g, p, num, all, Ans)
    else:
        dfs2(nxt, x, y + 1, a, g, p, num, all, Ans)
    g[x - 3][y] = 0
    nxt = mul(now, dec(1, a[x][y]))
    if y == 6:
        dfs2(nxt, x + 1, 1, a, g, p, num, all, Ans)
    else:
        dfs2(nxt, x, y + 1, a, g, p, num, all, Ans)

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    inv100 = power(100, MOD - 2)
    a = [[0] * (maxn) for _ in range(maxn)]
    index = 1
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for j in range(1, n + 1):
            a[i][j] = mul(int(data[index]), inv100)
            index += 1
    for i in range(n + 1, 7):
        a[i][i] = 1
    cnt = 0
    num = [[[0 for _ in range(8)] for _ in range(8)] for _ in range(8)]
    for i in range(1, 7):
        for j in range(i + 1, 7):
            for k in range(j + 1, 7):
                num[i][j][k] = 1 << cnt
                cnt += 1
    all_mask = (1 << cnt) - 1
    p = [0] * (1 << cnt)
    g = [[0] * 8 for _ in range(8)]
    dfs1(1, 1, 1, a, g, p, num)
    for j in range(cnt):
        for i in range(1 << cnt):
            if i & (1 << j):
                p[i] = inc(p[i], p[i ^ (1 << j)])
    Ans = [0]
    g = [[0] * 8 for _ in range(8)]
    dfs2(1, 4, 1, a, g, p, num, all_mask, Ans)
    Ans[0] = dec(1, Ans[0])
    print(Ans[0])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
